lines.en: Would you like to respond?
What would you like to say?
: First off, hot.
: Second, why'd you get a tattoo of a butterfly?
lines.zh: : 其次，你为什么纹了个蝴蝶？

lines.en: : First off, thanks <3
: Second, cause I like butterflies.
: They're pretty lol
: There's no deeper meaning to it?
lines.zh: : 没有什么更深的含义吗？

lines.en: : No hahah
: I just wanted a tattoo when I was younger and saw a cute butterfly design in the artist's book
lines.zh: : 我年轻的时候就是想纹个身，然后在纹身师的作品集里看到一个可爱的蝴蝶图案

lines.en: : So I was like one butterfly please and then that happened
lines.zh: : 于是我就说「来一只蝴蝶谢谢」，然后就变成这样了

lines.en: : You should get more
: You think?
: I wanna get one with Sana but she's afraid of needles lol
lines.zh: : 我想和 Sana 一起纹一个，可她怕针 lol

lines.en: : I'll try to talk her into it.
: Matching butterflies! Come with us! <3
: You're not going to make any money giving drinks away.
lines.zh: : 你这样白送酒是赚不到钱的。

lines.en: : [saramaster] come on
: I'm telling you I want you to come over lol
lines.zh: : 我都说了我想让你过来 lol

lines.en: : Why lure me with drinks when you can just take the rest of your clothes off?
lines.zh: : 你直接把剩下的衣服脱了不就行了，何必拿酒来引诱我？

lines.en: : The rest can come off when you get here :)
: Gotta make you work for it <3
lines.zh: : 总得让你付出点努力嘛 <3

lines.en: : Maybe some other time.
: Is there any Sunny D at your place?
lines.zh: : 你那儿有 Sunny D 吗？

lines.en: : What is that?
: We only have stuff from the local brewery
lines.zh: : 我们只有本地酿酒厂的东西

lines.en: : It's an orange concentrate drink from America.
lines.zh: : 是一种美国的橙味浓缩饮料。

lines.en: : And it's what I want right now.
: Is that really where your mind went after getting my picture?
lines.zh: : 收到我的照片之后，你脑子里想的就是这个？

lines.en: : I obviously don't have any Sunny D
: Then I will not be coming over tonight.
: Goodbye, Sara.
